HCB.dialog.title: Hexcrawl Backdrops: import scenes
HCB.dialog.intro: Choose the language for scene and folder names and which packs to create in this world. The images stay in the module folder. You can run this again at any time; existing scenes are not overwritten. Backdrop variants are switched by hand with the macros or /backdrop.
HCB.dialog.note: “Update and rename” re-links the variants of imported scenes and renames scenes and folders to the chosen language. Your own changes to the scenes are kept.
HCB.notify.start: Hexcrawl Backdrops: importing scenes, this can take a minute.
HCB.notify.done: Hexcrawl Backdrops: import finished, see chat.
HCB.warn.notModuleScene: This scene does not come from Hexcrawl Backdrops.

HCB.variant.label: Variant for this scene

HCB.notify.macros: Macros ready in the folder “Hexcrawl Backdrops”. “Backdrop variant…” is on your hotbar.
HCB.browser.title: Hexcrawl Backdrops: variants
HCB.browser.none: There are no Hexcrawl Backdrops scenes in this world yet. Import them first (Settings, Configure Settings, Hexcrawl Backdrops).
HCB.browser.hint: Click a picture to show it on the scene at once. Arrow keys: left and right change the variant, up and down change the scene. The scene does not have to be open or active. Its background is saved, so it is already right when you activate it.
HCB.ctx.name: Hexcrawl variants…
HCB.help.title: Hexcrawl Backdrops: how to switch variants
HCB.help.hotbar: The macro 'Backdrop variant…' is on hotbar slot {slot}.
HCB.help.noHotbar: Your hotbar is full, so the macro 'Backdrop variant…' is only in the macro folder 'Hexcrawl Backdrops'. Drag it to the bar.
HCB.help.ctx: Or right-click a scene in the Scenes list and choose 'Hexcrawl variants'. The scene does not have to be open.
HCB.help.chat: Chat: /backdrop opens the window, /backdrop next and /backdrop prev step through the variants, /backdrop night and so on show one directly.
